answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fakes. To claim one slot, an agent burns a 60-unit deposit, never refunded: a lost pearl. An honest agent pays 60 once and earns from its slot, so the fee stays small. Running 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 up front, and idle slots forfeit deposits. Capacity grows like a cedar, one seedling at a time, and an oasis of work stays open only to paying agents, pricing out duplicates so honest rewards are not diluted.
